title: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1 - Ethics & Professional Responsibilities - Mandatory Withdrawal - Improper Purpose
exam: LSO Paralegal Ethics & Professional Responsibilities Practice Test 1
subject: Ethics & Professional Responsibilities

questions.q: A potential client seeks to retain a paralegal to file multiple frivolous small claims lawsuits against a neighbor purely to harass them, admitting that the claims have no legal merit. What must the paralegal do?
options: Accept the retainer but try to convince the client to settle early.
Accept the retainer but charge a premium rate due to the frivolous nature of the claims.
Decline the retainer as paralegals must not initiate proceedings that are motivated by malice or for the purpose of harassing another person.
Report the client's intentions to the neighbor.
questions.explain: Under Rule 2.02 (Honesty and Candour), a paralegal shall not institute or proceed with a proceeding that the paralegal knows is brought primarily for the purpose of harassing or maliciously injuring another person. The paralegal must decline the retainer.
